current.text: The last Pelicans starting spot is between Jeremiah Fears and Jones. Dejounte Murray, Trey Murphy and Zion Williamson are locked in, and Yves Missi likely starts.
A Pelicans beat reporter expects Jeremiah Fears to start over Jones.
New Orleans has more rotation players than minutes, with about eight players who could start. This minutes crunch makes his role hard to project.
New coach Jamahl Mosley brings a defense-first identity to New Orleans.
Experts see the Pelicans as a weak team near the bottom of the West, at about 34 wins.
Experts are lukewarm on his draft value. One doubts he is worth drafting in standard category leagues. Another is not a big fan but places him in the right range for late-round steals.

durable.text: Steals are his clear best category. He adds some blocks and the occasional three.
He rarely shoots and scores little, so he is worth more in category leagues than in points leagues.
His projected FG% is weak for his position, which makes him a fit for punt FG% builds.
He is not a true floor spacer.
